question: How many layers does their model have?
title: FacTweet: Profiling Fake News Twitter Accounts
answer_rationale: The model includes an LSTM layer, an attention layer, and a softmax layer, as explicitly stated in the retrieved documents. Text 2 describes the model's architecture: 'We use an attention layer with dropout to attend over the most important tweets in each chunk. Finally, the representation is fed into a softmax layer to produce a probability distribution...'. Text 5 confirms the use of an LSTM layer. Thus, the model has three distinct layers.
